events.description: Anh Do adapts his best-selling memoir into a stand-up show. The performance blends humour with real-life stories.
events.title: Anh Do – The Happiest Refugee Live!

events.description: Three celebrated songwriters unite for a dream collaboration weaving voice, piano, strings and synths. The trio explores landscapes of nature and human yearning.
events.title: Emily-Rose and The Wild, Parvyn & Ofri

events.description: Bhuwin Khursija blends soulful originals with Qawwali, folk, and Sufi sounds. The show invites audiences on an emotional journey through music and poetry.
events.title: Noor-e-Dastaan by Bhuwin

events.description: Along the way, he discovers love, adventure and a secret hidden in the hills more precious than any treasure. • Babes in arms under 12 months are free to sit on the lap.
